disposition_reason: Reports total arsenic, arsenic species and 28 other elements (including lead, cadmium and mercury) in 58 retail rice samples from Zagreb, by rice type, with means, SDs and ranges.

study.origin: Italy 35, other EU 13 (Belgium, Germany, France, unspecified), Asia 12 (India, Pakistan, Thailand, Cambodia), unknown 3 (as printed; sums to 63 versus 58 samples)
study.market: markets, supermarkets and health food stores in Zagreb, Croatia
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7500cx) after microwave digestion for elements; HPLC-ICP-MS (Agilent 7900, PRP-X100) after 0.28 M HNO3 extraction for arsenic species
lod: As species LoD (ug/kg): tAs 0.006, AsIII 3.2, AsV 3.4, MMA 5.0, DMA 3.3; element LoDs in Table 3 footnote printed in ug/kg (e.g. Mg 0.003, Se 0.010)
study.qa: NIST SRM 1568b rice flour: arsenic species recovery 103%, tAs 283 vs certified 285 ug/kg; elements within 5% of certified values except K and Co (>=10%); duplicate digestion, triplicate analysis

findings.notes: Arsenic species by HPLC-ICP-MS after 0.28 M HNO3 extraction; dry weight.
